blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Following an interjection by Senator-judge Joel Villanueva, retired Chief Justice Artemio Panganiban clarified that he was speaking from the perspective of the Filipino people, rather than that of trial judges. Panganiban emphasized that senator-judges may frame their questions from a legislative viewpoint, but his concern was whether the impeachment proceedings would ultimately deliver genuine justice to the public.
